title: Isaac of Mosul
logline: A court musician rides a mystery basket up to a hidden salon, lies about who he is, and ends up carrying the caliph there in a second basket, where one careless word turns a secret visit into a royal wedding.
moral: Curiosity can open an unexpected door, a secret is safest with a loyal friend, and the truth slips out in the end.
tone: Light romantic comedy of disguise: playful, warm, a little conspiratorial; the one grave moment (the caliph's death) is shown quietly with an empty throne.

beats.summary: Isaac the musician leaves the caliph's gathering at night.
A big basket hangs on ropes from a high window.
Curious and tipsy, he sits in it.
Servants haul him up, taking him for an expected guest.
A young lady enters and asks how he came.
He hides his real trade and claims to be a merchant.
He returns night after night and forgets the time.
He leaves court without leave; the caliph is angry.
The confession delights the caliph, who wants to come.
Disguised, the two rise in two baskets.
The caliph calls Isaac by his real name and orders him to sing.
The lady realises the guest is the caliph and withdraws.
The house is Hasan bin Sahl's; she is his daughter Khadijah.
The caliph asks for her hand and sets a great dowry.
Isaac keeps the secret until the caliph's death.
The secret visit became a wedding in the palace.

Right: the house wall x 380..1000 from y -900 to 900, navy-blue with brick ticks and blue Ben-Day dots, two dark shuttered windows at y 250 and y -100, a closed door x 760..900 at ground level. props.description: hangingBasket (new): woven carrying basket big enough for a seated adult. Rim 210 wide, base 160 wide, 150 tall, yellow-brown with brown weave diagonals and red dot shade, thick black brush rim. Four ropes from the rim to a knot 170 above it, then one rope to the beam. Fields: x, y (base centre), swingA, dip, taut 0..1 (rope sag to straight), flowers (S19), front/back passes so a seated person can be drawn inside.
second instance of hangingBasket on the rope at x 290 (S10).

oud (new): short-necked lute, pear body 70 x 95 in brown with a yellow face, round sound hole, bent-back peg head, 4 string lines; total 150 long. Fields x, y, rot, strum (string wobble 0..1). Held under an arm, across the chest, on a knee or hidden behind the back.

candle (new, small): brass stick 60 tall with a drip pan, white candle with h 15..120, flame 22 tall on a seeded flicker, optional halftone light disc r 150 (planned lampLight). Carried by the maids and standing on the salon table.
throne (planned by AN-084): high-backed, seat 48 above its base, 150 wide, back 300 high with a pointed arch and finial. The crown can rest on the seat (S9, S17).
crownProp (planned by AN-046): gold three-point crown drawn solid or as a dashed ghost; here it lowers onto the plain turban at 117.76 and turns solid.
Wooden chest 170 x 110 with yellow bands and a hinged lid (open 0..1) filled by the planned coinPile (fill 0..1) with the planned goldGlow behind it.
scroll (planned by AN-095): small paper roll 60 x 80 with squiggle lines, held in one hand; can lie on the floor.

subtitles.ar: خرج الموسيقي إسحاق الموصلي ليلًا من مجلس الخليفة المأمون.|وفي زقاق مظلم لمح سلة كبيرة معلقة بحبال من نافذة|عالية. دفعه الفضول والشراب إلى الجلوس|فيها، فإذا بخدم البيت يرفعونه ظانين أنه زائر منتظر.
subtitles.en: One night musician Isaac of Mosul|noticed a large basket hanging from an upper window.|Curious and affected by wine, he climbed in;|servants raised him, mistaking him for an expected visitor.

subtitles.ar: استقبلته خادمات يحملن الشموع، وقدنه إلى قاعة فاخرة.|دخلت سيدة شابة وسألته كيف وصل إلى منزلها.|قص عليها خبر السلة، لكنه أخفى عمله الحقيقي،|وقال إنه تاجر من سوق بغداد.
subtitles.en: Servants led him into a splendid hall,|where a young woman asked how he had arrived.|Isaac explained the basket but concealed his profession,|claiming to be a Baghdad merchant.

subtitles.ar: عاد إسحاق في الليلة التالية، ثم في ليلة ثالثة،|وصار ينسى الوقت حين يجلس عندها.|وفي إحدى الزيارات ترك مجلس المأمون بغير إذن،|فغضب الخليفة واستدعاه ليسأله عن سبب غيابه.
subtitles.en: Isaac returned on two more nights,|becoming so absorbed|that he once left al-Ma’mun’s gathering without permission.|The angry caliph demanded an explanation.

subtitles.ar: أخبر إسحاق المأمون سر السلة والسيدة التي تحب الشعر والموسيقى.|أعجب الخليفة بحكايته وطلب مرافقته.|اتفقا على إخفاء اسميهما،|وجلس كل واحد في سلة، ثم صعدا إلى المنزل في الليل.
subtitles.en: In private, Isaac described the remarkable hostess.|The caliph wished to meet her,|so they hid their identities|and rose to the house in two baskets.

subtitles.ar: رحبت السيدة بالضيفين وأسمعتهما شعرًا وغناء.|حاول إسحاق المحافظة على السر، لكن المأمون ناداه باسمه الحقيقي وأمره بالغناء.|أدركت السيدة عندئذ أن الرجل الذي ظنته ضيفًا عاديًا|هو الخليفة نفسه، فانصرفت.
subtitles.en: The hostess entertained them with verse and song,|until al-Ma’mun accidentally addressed Isaac by name and title.|Realizing the other visitor was the caliph,|she withdrew.

subtitles.ar: سأل المأمون عن صاحب المنزل،|فعلم أنه الحسن بن سهل، وأن السيدة ابنته خديجة.|استدعاه وسأله هل تزوجت ابنته،|فلما علم أنها غير متزوجة طلب يدها، وحدد لها مهرًا كبيرًا.
subtitles.en: Al-Ma’mun learned the house belonged to Hasan bin Sahl|and the woman was his daughter Khadijah.|He asked to marry her|and promised a substantial marriage settlement.

subtitles.ar: غادر المأمون مع إسحاق، وطلب منه ألا يخبر أحدًا بما جرى.|حفظ إسحاق السر حتى وفاة الخليفة،|ثم روى كيف قادته سلة غريبة إلى لقاءات لا تُنسى،|وكيف تحولت الزيارة السرية إلى زواج في القصر.
subtitles.en: The caliph told Isaac to keep the affair secret.|Isaac did so until al-Ma’mun’s death,|then recounted how a strange basket led to extraordinary meetings|and a royal marriage.

new_assets.name: palaceHall
new_assets.description: The planned arched interior (AN-084, AN-045, AN-095...) with two dressings used here: "court" (dais, throne, door arch with sky) and "salon" (balcony arch, inner door, cushions, low table, warm wall).
new_assets.implementation: One function palaceHall(ctx, o) baked once per dressing with bake(): fillRect wall + style dots, three pointed arches as two quadratic curves each, evenodd clip for the open arch showing skyCycle, checker floor from y 900 as skewed quads, dais as a box, carpet strip, lamps as small shapes with an optional lit disc. Options: variant, dais, throne, cushions[], table, garlands, night.

new_assets.name: nightAlley
new_assets.description: Tall night lane with a high lit window, beam and pulley, for vertical lifts; dawn option. Reusable for any balcony, window, rope or night-street scene.
new_assets.implementation: bake() a 1000 x 2130 canvas (y -900..1230, drawn with a +900 offset): navy wall rect with seeded brick ticks and blue dots, shutters as rects, window as a yellow rect with halftone halo (style dots in a radial clip), beam as a brown box with a pulley circle, Library nightCity strip and skyCycle behind. Ropes and baskets are drawn live. The camera y simply goes negative for the crane.

new_assets.name: hangingBasket
new_assets.description: Person-sized woven basket on ropes with swing, dip and taut fields, front and back passes, optional flowers.
new_assets.implementation: Trapezoid path with weave lines clipped to it, brush rim ellipse (back half in the back pass, front half and body in the front pass). Ropes: 4 lines to a knot then a polyline to the beam point; taut blends a sagging quadratic to a straight line. Passenger: person {sit:1, seat:"floor"} drawn between the passes at the basket base + 10, moving and rotating with the basket (ctx.translate/rotate about the knot).

new_assets.name: oud
new_assets.description: The musician's lute, 150 long, with a strum wobble.
new_assets.implementation: Ellipse/pear path body, rect neck, angled peg head, 4 lines; strum offsets the line midpoints by a seeded sine. Positioned from P.hands (person returns hand positions).

new_assets.name: candle
new_assets.description: Candlestick with melt height, flicker and optional light disc.
new_assets.implementation: Rects and a teardrop flame scaled by K.noise flicker; drips as small circles; light disc reuses the planned lampLight (yellow halftone disc r 150).

new_assets.name: musicNotes
new_assets.description: n quaver glyphs released from a point that rise on seeded S-paths, rock and fade; colour black with a yellow or red head.
new_assets.implementation: musicNotes(ctx, x, y, t - t0, {n, seed, spread, rise}): each note = filled ellipse head + stem + flag, position from K.rng(seed + i) path, alpha from age. Pure function of t.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: The planned wordless picture balloon (AN-014, AN-036...), single and strip modes, for house?, basket, merchant, rings?.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded white box with a brush outline and a tail to the speaker; callback draws 1 to 3 flat icons; pop with overshoot. Place with a clear-of-faces check by hand.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: The planned round picture-in-picture with an iris (9 stories): servants at the window (S3), portraits of Hasan and Khadijah (S14).
new_assets.implementation: ctx.arc clip in panel space, draw the sub-scene with its own camera, brush ring outline; iris = radius eased 0 -> r.

new_assets.name: throne
new_assets.implementation: Box seat, tall back with pointed arch path, finial circle, red cushion; crown may be drawn on the seat.

new_assets.name: coinPile
new_assets.description: Planned coin mound (AN-041, AN-045, AN-084) inside a simple chest with a hinged lid, with the planned goldGlow.
new_assets.implementation: Chest = two rects + lid quad rotated about the back hinge; coinPile fill 0..1 as seeded yellow ellipses stacked in a mound; goldGlow rays behind.

new_assets.name: crownProp
new_assets.description: Planned gold crown, solid or dashed ghost (AN-046).
new_assets.implementation: Three-point polygon with circles; ghost = setLineDash stroke only.

new_assets.name: sneak
new_assets.description: The planned tiptoe option for walk() (AN-045, AN-075, KD-026), used 62.58..64.5.
new_assets.implementation: walk() variant: higher knee amplitude and a 0.12 s hold at each toe contact, phase still from distance travelled.

owner_questions: Wine: the script says curiosity and drink pushed him into the basket; default chosen is a mild woozy sway, flushed cheeks and one HIC! with no cup or bottle shown. Confirm or remove the HIC!.
The caliph's death (155.44) is shown only as an empty throne with the crown on the seat and a lamp going out; no body or funeral. Confirm.

Staging addition: the proposal to Hasan bin Sahl (131.7 to 144.5) is staged in Hasan's own hall the same night, so that "he left with Isaac" follows in order; the script does not say where he was summoned. Confirm.
Staging addition: the old Isaac tells the tale to two children (157.7 on); the script only says he later told it. Confirm the listeners.
The disguised caliph keeps his red robe and beard and only swaps crown and cape for a plain turban, so viewers can follow him. Confirm this light disguise.

Invented English lettering to confirm: HIC!, HEAVE!, HO!, WOW!, SHH!, OH NO!, GRRR!, FETCH HIM!, OHO!, ME TOO!, UP!, ISAAC!, SING!, GASP!, YES!, plus labels (BIG BASKET, THE GUEST?, NIGHT 2, NIGHT 3, NO PERMISSION!, SECRET, TELL NO ONE, A GREAT DOWRY, ROYAL WEDDING).

The English subtitle for paragraph 1 leaves out the caliph's gathering and the alley that the Arabic narrates (0 to 9 s), so its first chunk stays on screen a long time; default is to keep the supplied English verbatim.
implementation_notes: Paragraph 3 is absent by design: paragraphs are 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. Do not renumber; timing.json keeps the same numbers.
All cue times are word starts from planning/inputs/timeline.md on the final MP3 (168.89 s). Film length 172.39 s (end_hold 3.5).
Three baked sets only: palaceHall("court"), palaceHall("salon"), nightAlley. The alley is taller than the standard world: its camera clamp must allow y from -900 + 615/zoom to 1230 - 615/zoom.

Basket lift = one function liftY(t, t0, t1, pulls) returning the base y from 860 to -400 in stepped pulls (surge 0.12 s, drop back 6 units); basket, passenger, rope taut value and camera all read it. Reuse for S3, S6 (fast), S10 (two baskets offset 0.2 s) and the S18 cloud.
Passenger in a basket: person {sit:1, seat:"floor"} between the basket back and front passes; hands on the rim with handLW/handRW world targets.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so every figure blinks; add hand blinks where lid is set. Use noBlink during the freeze at 107.96..109.1.
Every character always has a gaze target (lookAt / gazePlan). Listeners watch the speaker; saccades (ease 0.07) for sneaking and nervous beats.
The disguise swap at 86.32 is a costume switch under a 6-frame star puff (dustBurst + stars); the reverse (crown back) happens with the crownGhost at 117.76; from S16 he is costume caliph again.
Use arm angles (aL/aR) for the HEAVE rope pose and the strum so they read at phone size; that pose is set up in S3, replayed by Isaac in S5 and by old Isaac in S18.
Balloons, clouds, labels and portrait circles live in the upper part of the panel and must never cover a face; lettering sizes: headlines >= 44 px, labels >= 28 px at 1280x720 scale; no dashes.
Sound: only the eight listed effects, all in narration pauses or after the last word, SND master 0.6.
Apply any shake inside the panel clip only (template); the caption panel never moves.
When approved, move palaceHall, nightAlley, hangingBasket, oud, candle and musicNotes into Library/ with registry entries, then run node Library/tests/regression.mjs.
warnings: Subtitle P6 chunk 2 is 12 Arabic words and P8 chunk 1 is 11: check the Arabic font size fits the caption panel in three lines at most.
The English translation is a summary and does not track the Arabic sentence by sentence; English chunks are placed at the nearest matching Arabic chunk.
The tall alley set needs negative camera y; check the template camAt clamp.
S5 is 16.5 s in one two-shot: the icon balloons and the oud-hiding gag must carry it; keep the push-in moving.
Seated figures inside a basket must not show feet through the weave: draw order back pass, person, front pass.
Sfx are limited to the pauses listed in timeline.md; do not add effects elsewhere without checking word ends in timeline.json.
